MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Value Addition.

   D. Decomposers only

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)

   B. Milk souring
   C. Paper burning to ash

7. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
